== Summary ==
Alex Tennet in the Top 16 portrait grid of the 2002 Decipher ''Lord of the Rings'' TCG World Championship (DecipherCon 2002). Cropped to head and shoulders from the grid shown on the LOTR-TCG Wiki page [https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Worlds_2002 Worlds 2002] (image: https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/images/wc_2002_top_16.jpg), where the portrait is labelled with his name.
* Page preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260208104034/https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Worlds_2002 Internet Archive]
* Image preserved copy: none yet (Wayback save failed 13 October 2026)
* Photographer: unknown (Decipher/DGMA event coverage, inferred).
